'''Roenni''' was a young girl who was a member of [[the Young]]. When [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] left the underground to meet with the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] leaders, he asked Roenni to care about the injured [[Tahl]].<ref name="DotD" /> When the [[Young–Elders War]] began, Roenni helped the Young to destroy the Elders' ship hangar, an event that convinced [[Middle Generation|The Middle Generation]] to join [[the Young]] and eventually led to the Young victory. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was banished from [[the Young]] by [[Nield]], Roenni was the only person who helped him.<ref name="TUP" />

==Hangar attack==
The major [[Attack on the Elders' spaceport|attack]] that caused the Middle Generation to join the Young was just a small group made up of Obi-Wan Kenobi, [[Cerasi]], Nield and Roenni. Although Roenni was small, [[Roenni's father|her father]] had been a technician, and Roenni had grown up around all types of equipment. She was especially good with [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutters]]. When Roenni had disabled the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the four jumped back down the grate they had come up and escaped at the last second, before Obi-Wan threw in a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] and the entire hangar exploded.<ref name="TUP" />

==Personality and traits==
Roenni was a quiet girl and a member of the Young, a group made up of the younger generation of people on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] that wished to end the centuries-long conflict between the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]].<ref name="DotD" />
